purpose: Full-body founder reference for 3D model generation
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full-body front-view character reference for 3D model generation.
Create a single adult startup founder with medium-brown skin, short hair, neutral expression, realistic human anatomy and proportions. One person only. Front view, centred, straight-on camera with minimal perspective distortion, entire head to feet and both extended hands fully in frame with clear margins. Square composition suitable for a full T-pose.
Strict T-pose: torso upright facing directly forward, arms fully straight horizontally out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down toward the floor. Each hand has exactly five anatomically correct fingers, all straight and spread apart with clear gaps; thumbs angled away from the hands. Legs straight and slightly apart, feet forward. Make the fingers and bare hands clearly readable for 3D reconstruction while preserving palms-down orientation.
Fitted dark charcoal hoodie, hood down, sleeves pushed up to mid-forearm so forearms and hands are bare. Dark jeans and plain white sneakers. Realistic fabric and natural skin texture.
Plain uniform light-grey background, soft even shadowless studio lighting, no cast shadows, no floor shadow. No watch, rings, bag, phone, props, jewelry, logos, text, labels, watermark, multiple views, panels, or extra people. No cropping, bent arms, A-pose, clenched fingers, fused fingers or extra digits.
refinement_prompt: Edit only the hands and fingers of this full-body founder reference. Keep the same person, face, neutral expression, body, clothing, pose, framing and lighting unchanged. Both arms must remain completely horizontal in a strict T-pose, elbows straight. Palms face downward. Correct each hand to exactly five straight fingers (four fingers plus a thumb), widely and distinctly splayed, with visible light-grey negative-space gaps between every adjacent digit from this front camera. Spread the four fingers as widely as anatomically possible and use slight individual finger elevation so they do not visually merge from the front; keep the wrists neutral and the palms oriented downward, not facing the viewer. Thumbs spread distinctly away. Hands stay realistic and proportional. No fused or overlapping finger silhouettes, no bent or curled fingers, no extra fingers. Keep the entire body head to feet and both hands uncropped. Make background uniformly light grey with no cast shadow.
